scope: Bounded independent static review of the current five iteration19 production modules and two new test files against their saved baseline, plus existing test receipts. No models, services or tests launched; no production/test changes by reviewer.

checks.detail: Existing root-owned v2 run: exit 0; 755 passed in 5.78s; unchanged_during_test true; log hash matches. This reviewer did not run tests.
AST parsing only, no production imports or execution.
Whole positive command parser plus actual fixed-map place_ambiguous source query excludes unsupported unknown/compound, route-preview, question and negation requests from derived continuation.

Prior execution must be nonstale and valid; matching outcome must be error with result status=error, code=place_ambiguous, destination role and normalized original query. A missing/mismatched result does not ground a continuation.

Unique _lookup success alone is insufficient. Answer must match full normalized canonical name, canonical ID, existing exact alias, or safe internal in/at connective form; a paused unique partial such as Manipal is rejected. Explicit commands, questions and composite answers do not become literal answers.

Recognized continuation explicitly requires complete and nonempty calls, then existing destination-matching compute_route -> exactly one start_navigation dependency contract. No calls are silently added.

Resolve and one repair retain original history/slots/outcomes, literal latest answer, separate original_request/canonical request context and rejected parsed JSON. Second contract error follows existing failure path. Parser-level network retry count is outside this assertion.

Last execution context is consumed on next finalized turn; merged uncommitted answer retains it. Commit clears pending context, and close clears both context fields. Committed cancellation/unrelated request or successful navigation does not leave the old ambiguity available to a later place answer.

Current-intent/closed checks prevent late executor results from storing context, late summaries from speaking, and synchronous rejection-event corrections from starting repair or dispatch. Continuation event payloads are deep-copied so subscriber mutation cannot change planning/summary context.

Unknown/place-error handling retains priority. Canonical continuation enters the existing result/status/stale/ancestry/snapshot/word-limit summary path; model repaired_request is not authorization. Fallback receives full original plus clarification and actual results.

37 domain trajectories/checks include five canonical/alias/connective successes, independent Tech Park and Indiranagar cases, actual known replacement outside original candidates, no-call/incomplete/lookup repair, and negative source/answer/outcome guards. Nine lifecycle cases cover context consumption, split answer, late execution/close, old summary, trace mutation and synchronous rejection correction.
lifecycle-incomplete-regression.txt retains 1 failed, 8 passed before the full-name guard; its failing split-answer case passes in the later v2 full suite. Receipt is not overwritten.

explicit_boundaries: Returned-error, skipped and cancelled navigation outcomes remain eligible. The hook excludes done/reused/blocked/unknown effects but does not prove that every eligible error happened before backend entry; correctness relies on current car handlers returning errors before mutation. It is not a generic retry policy for arbitrary external writes.

A complete known replacement destination may be outside the original ambiguity candidates (Road -> Cubbon Park is explicitly covered). This is literal destination correction, not automatic candidate selection.

Unknown-place strings, compound/qualified requests, model-only no-call clarification without matching tool error, unsupported answer phrasing and incomplete partial answers do not gain this contract. They retain ordinary model planning; no general dialogue-completion guarantee is asserted.
The hook recognizes the whole merged uncommitted answer when the planner previously marked it incomplete; it does not enforce arbitrary semantic completion for all unsupported fragments.
The source retains at most one prior execution context per coordinator. It is not durable cross-session task state.

Passing deterministic fixtures/full tests does not establish live STT/LLM/TTS or acoustic success. The saved iteration18 failure remains a failed development observation; no live iteration19 result was evaluated here.
